mapper.select: select call_record_id callRecordId,lead_id leadId,todo_id todoId,call_channel callChannel, external_call_id externalCallId,started_at startedAt,ended_at endedAt,duration_seconds durationSeconds, call_result callResult,recording_file_object_id recordingFileObjectId,manual_notes manualNotes, provider_summary_hash providerSummaryHash,idempotency_key idempotencyKey,create_by createBy from biz_lead_call_record where idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
select count(*) from biz_lead_call_record where lead_id=#{leadId} and todo_id=#{todoId}

select review_id reviewId,lead_id leadId,reason_code reasonCode,sales_explanation salesExplanation, submitted_by submittedBy,submitted_at submittedAt,reviewer_id reviewerId,review_result reviewResult, review_comment reviewComment,reviewed_at reviewedAt,system_default systemDefault,todo_id todoId, status,idempotency_key idempotencyKey,row_version rowVersion from biz_lead_invalid_review where review_id=#{reviewId}

select review_id reviewId,lead_id leadId,reason_code reasonCode,sales_explanation salesExplanation, submitted_by submittedBy,submitted_at submittedAt,reviewer_id reviewerId,review_result reviewResult, review_comment reviewComment,reviewed_at reviewedAt,system_default systemDefault,todo_id todoId, status,idempotency_key idempotencyKey,row_version rowVersion from biz_lead_invalid_review where lead_id=#{leadId} and todo_id=#{todoId} order by review_id desc limit 1

select review_id reviewId,lead_id leadId,reason_code reasonCode,sales_explanation salesExplanation, submitted_by submittedBy,submitted_at submittedAt,reviewer_id reviewerId,review_result reviewResult, review_comment reviewComment,reviewed_at reviewedAt,system_default systemDefault,todo_id todoId, status,idempotency_key idempotencyKey,row_version rowVersion from biz_lead_invalid_review where idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
mapper.update: update biz_lead_invalid_review set reviewer_id=#{reviewerId},review_result=#{result},review_comment=#{comment},reviewed_at=sysdate(), system_default=#{systemDefault},status='COMPLETED',row_version=row_version+1, update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where review_id=#{reviewId} and status='PENDING' and row_version=#{expectedRowVersion}
mapper.select: select retry_record_id retryRecordId,lead_id leadId,plan_id planId,window_code windowCode, attempt_no attemptNo,contact_result contactResult,next_window_code nextWindowCode,todo_id todoId, call_record_id callRecordId,occurred_at occurredAt,idempotency_key idempotencyKey from biz_lead_retry_record where idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}

select quality_record_id qualityRecordId,lead_id leadId,sales_user_id salesUserId,reason_code reasonCode, reviewer_id reviewerId,source_todo_id sourceTodoId,source_review_id sourceReviewId, quality_type qualityType,idempotency_key idempotencyKey from biz_lead_quality_record where idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}

select dead_pool_log_id deadPoolLogId,lead_id leadId,action_type actionType,reason_code reasonCode, reason_detail reasonDetail,from_disposition fromDisposition,to_disposition toDisposition, operator_id operatorId,source_todo_id sourceTodoId,action_time actionTime,idempotency_key idempotencyKey from biz_lead_dead_pool_log where idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
mapper.update: update biz_business_tag_rel set confirm_status=#{confirmStatus},confirmed_by=#{confirmedBy}, confirmed_at=sysdate(),update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where tag_rel_id=#{tagRelationId} and business_type='LEAD' and business_id=#{leadId} and confirm_status in ('PENDING','CORRECTED')
mapper.select: select business_id from biz_business_tag_rel where tag_rel_id=#{tagRelationId} and business_type='LEAD'
select plan_id from todo_schedule_plan where business_type='LEAD' and business_id=#{leadId} and status='ACTIVE' order by plan_id desc limit 1

select policy_id policyId,policy_code policyCode,policy_name policyName, sales_dept_id salesDeptId,source_code sourceCode,business_type businessType, retry_rule_json retryRuleJson,status,row_version rowVersion from biz_lead_assignment_policy where sales_dept_id=#{salesDeptId} and business_type='LEAD' and status='ACTIVE' and source_code in (#{sourceCode},'*') order by case when source_code=#{sourceCode} then 0 else 1 end,policy_id limit 1
select user_id from biz_lead_assignment_policy_candidate where policy_id=#{policyId} and status='ACTIVE' order by sort_order,user_id

select policy.policy_id policyId,policy.policy_code policyCode,policy.policy_name policyName, policy.sales_dept_id salesDeptId,policy.source_code sourceCode, policy.business_type businessType,policy.retry_rule_json retryRuleJson, policy.status,policy.row_version rowVersion from biz_lead_assignment_policy policy where policy.business_type='LEAD'
and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role role_scope on role_scope.role_id=ur.role_id and role_scope.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( role_scope.data_scope='1' or (role_scope.data_scope='2' and policy.sales_dept_id in ( select rd.dept_id from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id=role_scope.role_id)) or (role_scope.data_scope='3' and policy.sales_dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (role_scope.data_scope='4' and policy.sales_dept_id in ( select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId},sd.ancestors))) ) )
order by policy.sales_dept_id,policy.source_code,policy.policy_id

select candidate.policy_id policyId,candidate.user_id userId,user.user_name userName, user.nick_name nickName,candidate.sort_order sortOrder, coalesce(availability.status,'AVAILABLE') availabilityStatus, delegation.to_user_id delegateUserId from biz_lead_assignment_policy_candidate candidate join sys_user user on user.user_id=candidate.user_id left join sys_user_availability availability on availability.availability_id=( select max(latest.availability_id) from sys_user_availability latest where latest.user_id=candidate.user_id and latest.effective_from<=sysdate() and (latest.effective_to is null or latest.effective_to>sysdate())) left join sys_user_delegation delegation on delegation.delegation_id=( select max(latest_delegation.delegation_id) from sys_user_delegation latest_delegation where latest_delegation.from_user_id=candidate.user_id and latest_delegation.status='ACTIVE' and latest_delegation.effective_from<=sysdate() and (latest_delegation.effective_to is null or latest_delegation.effective_to>sysdate())) where candidate.status='ACTIVE' and candidate.policy_id in #{id} order by candidate.policy_id,candidate.sort_order,candidate.user_id

select policy_id policyId,policy_code policyCode,policy_name policyName, sales_dept_id salesDeptId,source_code sourceCode,business_type businessType, retry_rule_json retryRuleJson,status,row_version rowVersion from biz_lead_assignment_policy where policy_id=#{policyId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into biz_lead_assignment_policy( policy_code,policy_name,sales_dept_id,source_code,business_type,retry_rule_json, status,row_version,create_by,create_time) values(#{policyCode},#{policyName},#{salesDeptId},#{sourceCode},'LEAD', cast(#{retryRuleJson} as json),'ACTIVE',0,#{createBy},sysdate())
mapper.update: update biz_lead_assignment_policy set policy_name=#{policyName},sales_dept_id=#{salesDeptId},source_code=#{sourceCode}, retry_rule_json=cast(#{retryRuleJson} as json),row_version=row_version+1, update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where policy_id=#{policyId} and business_type='LEAD' and status='ACTIVE' and row_version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select user_id from sys_user where status='0' and del_flag='0' and dept_id=#{salesDeptId} and user_id in #{id} order by user_id
